data.message: I propose a renewable quota: each of us requests 10 tons this month, totaling 250 and leaving 250. That guarantees next month's stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome, yielding $10,000 each month indefinitely if maintained. I intend to request 10 if this plan gains broad support. Please state whether you support the 10-ton quota; requests above it risk everyone's future income.
